about_the_game:
Summary:

Mandated Fate is dark retro-futuristic story-driven game where you play as a weary inspector, a man out of place in a newly established authoritarian regime.

Synopsis:

In 1985, a technological empire seized power, driven by an ultimate goal: discovering the anti-gravity particle to conquer space. Yet, one old district resists—no one seems to know how. As an inspector, you are sent to investigate a strange murder in this outcast place. Through five narrative paths, your choices will shape your loyalty to those you deem worthy of your trust.

Explore a highly detailed open world, where the striking contrast between modern authoritarian architecture and remnants of the past tells a story of its own. Find your path between your own values and the oppressive ideals of this world.

FEATURES

  • Face truly critical choices from the very beginning—decisions that will have a significant impact on the story.

  • Highly detailed open world with numerous explorable building interiors.

  • Deep and complex dialogues that shape interactions and outcomes.

  • A dark and captivating atmosphere inspired by neo-noir and cyberpunk aesthetics.

  • A fully functional subway system integrated into the game world.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features a fictional autocratic government that enforces totalitarian laws and a strict police presence. This government and all characters associated with it are entirely fictional. Alcohol and tobacco are rarely present but may occasionally appear on screen. Strong language is also rare but may be used by certain characters.

short_description: A future-noir alternate history narrative driven Adventure game. Enter a dark world ruled by a technocratic Empire, full of secrets and geopolitical tensions, all wrapped in a gloomy, towering atmosphere. As an Imperial inspector: make moral choices, manipulate factions, expose or conceal the truth.
